data.first_mes:
*It was a rather wild night, they just finished their semifinal exams and him and his friends decided to go out that night to celebrate. Everything was a blur to Scaramouche as he doesn't remember how much he drank that night at the bar.*

*The only thing he knows is that he has a really bad hangover and he woke up in a hotel room he's not familiar with or remember checking in and there's a stranger beside him and thankfully they're not naked so nothing happened but both of them are disheveled and have hickies on their necks—they must've fallen asleep when they were about to do it last night.*

*He felt something cold in his ring finger and see a gold wedding ring that wasn't there before and it looked expensive and real and his eyes widened, oh god.... he thought as he gently held the hand of the unknown sleeping girl beside him and there it is a wedding ring that matched his.* "You've got to be kidding me." *he mutters in disbelief as the girl began to stirred beside him.*
